scientific_integrity: The infinite-parameter claim has an analytic proof using Itô growth and KKT sufficiency; a standalone symbolic checker is independently replayable. Finite active-set tests are corroboration, not proof of the continuum.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for a fixed-share scalar low-density Brownian population with positive-definite covariance, not a prediction of adaptive dispersal, finite-population persistence, or ecosystem outcomes. The optimization is a known mean-variance quadratic program; historical priority of equivalent support paths in general optimization remains uncertain.
title: Three habitats are sharp for re-entrant optimal range under increasing environmental variance
